column1: # Route catalog for scripts/fleet-assert.sh. Do not invent rows -- method/path/role are
# declaration tuples taken from the code (recipe below), and a test holds them to it.
# Columns: method, path, role, bucket, notes  (tab-separated)
# bucket/notes were carried over from a 2026-08-25 route-coverage inventory (retired from
# internal-docs once this table superseded it; git history has it), built the same way
# -- cross-checked 1:1 against a route_declarations() dump when it was built
# (2026-08-25: 224/224 rows matched, zero unmatched on either side). Four rows are marked
# RESOLVED where that investigation replaced the doc's 'Undetermined' verdict with a real answer
# (two real bugs kept in bucket=Now so fleet-assert.sh asserts them and fails loudly;
# two false alarms moved to bucket=Ext, see their notes).
# That match no longer holds, and the table is NOT complete. As of 2026-10-05
# route_declarations() returns 311 routes and 211 of them have a row here; 32 rows name a
# route oxy-app does not declare itself (the org, onboarding and source-upload trees moved
# to the surface crates oxy-server mounts; a few workspace routes were removed or
# re-nested). The agentic-airway rows were rebuilt from a fresh dump after #3451, and the
# analytics rows when its coordinator routes were declared one by one.
# What holds the rows to the code: crates/app/tests/routing/fleet_routes_table.rs fails
#   when a row states a role other than the one declared for its method + path, when the
#   agentic-airway or analytics rows are not exactly agentic_http::airway_router_roles() /
#   router_roles(), or when a row is not five tab-separated columns. It does NOT fail when a route is added elsewhere
#   without a row -- nothing does; fleet-assert.sh reports coverage of the rows it is given.
# To regenerate the method/path/role columns: add a temporary #[test] to
#   tuple sorted+deduped, and writes it to a scratch file. Run it with:
#   then delete the temporary test (git diff against the test file must come back
#   empty). This is the recipe this file's rows came from.
# bucket values: Now (buildable today) | Fixture (needs a fixture, mostly uncovered
#   here) | Destr (destructive; only disposable create/read/delete lifecycles are run)
#   | Ext (not buildable -- needs an external system/credential absent from this fleet)
#   | Struct (404 by construction -- a nest_all/nest_typed bare-prefix companion, not
#   independently addressable; the real surface is the neighboring {*rest} row. Also a
#   {*rest} catch-all whose routes each have a row of their own, so nothing reaches it).
